definition: Projected fixed-prefix nu_hat = unbiased squared norm of the mean proper-top16 KL gradient divided by twice the proper-top16 KL.
parameter_subspace: last transformer block plus final norm
prefixes: same 64 frozen validation trajectories at every checkpoint
warning: The biased/unbiased estimator gap is a finite-sample sensitivity comparison, not a confidence interval. RL is measured only at step 0.
